body.name: Row-restricted and kernel-compatible matchings
body.construction: Define \(\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{row}}(\Pi_A\mathbf K)=\{\mu\in\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{obs}}(\mathscr R(Q)):\mu(\rho_i(\Pi_A\mathbf K))=i\text{ for all }i\in A\}\).  For \(\mu\in\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{obs}}(\mathscr R(Q))\), normalize the row matched to label \(i\) to have coordinate \(i\) equal to one, stack these rows as \(Q^\mu\), and set \(B^\mu=I_n-Q^\mu\).  Define \(\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{ker}}(\Pi_A\mathbf K)\) as the set of such \(\mu\) for which there are mutually independent nonconstant non-Gaussian sources \(\varepsilon^\mu\), with no location or moment restriction, such that the square mechanism \((B^\mu,\varepsilon^\mu)\) is solvable in every regime in \(\mathcal I_A^{\mathrm{atom}}\) and generates exactly \(\Pi_A\mathbf K\).
